title: Quantum announces Atlas III Viking II and Fireball SE
scope_note: Contemporary report dates Quantum's June 3 announcement and records October 1997 Fireball SE mass production; Atlas III and Viking II are 1998-production omission leads.

title: IBM and Maxtor announce high-capacity 3.5-inch IDE HDDs
scope_note: Contemporary report gives Deskstar 8 June samples and July production plus DiamondMax 1750 planned late-June and late-July production; OEM and retail channels differ.

title: Quantum Bigfoot TX historical product note
scope_note: Retrospective technical note says Bigfoot TX was announced October 30 1997 and mass production began early November; it is not contemporaneous proof of retail availability.

title: COMDEX Fall 1997 report on IBM Deskstar 18GP
scope_note: Contemporary report says IBM announced the OEM-only Deskstar 18GP immediately before COMDEX and expected PCs using it no earlier than three to four months later.
